description: 京浜東北線・中央総武緩行線の実在線路、主要道路、選定駅550m圏の道路。範囲外・未収録道路・時刻表は対象外。実在の建物への入居を示さない。
limitations: OSM is incomplete; only downloaded connected topology is used; no gap-filling edges.
Rail directions follow ordered route-relation stops; no train timetable or live service.
Station entry is a labelled estimate from a public walk node within 180m, not a surveyed entrance, accessible entrance guarantee, or invented road geometry.
Transfers only between retained services at the same named station; no interstation jumps.
Conditional access and unsupported via-way/conditional turn restrictions are excluded conservatively; some possible real car routes are therefore unavailable.
Driving speeds and dwell/wait/parking are conservative assumptions, not traffic predictions.
Transit is unknown when either commute direction falls outside 06:00–22:00.
Fictional sites and homes use public road nodes; no actual building occupancy is asserted.

job_field_sources.use: 求人申込み・紹介・応募手続きの項目参考。求人広告の転載・収集なし。
業務・就業場所の変更範囲、契約更新基準・更新上限の項目参考。

source_distribution: The routing-only sanitized OSM source is retained for offline rebuilding under source/. Business names, contacts, addresses and contributor metadata are excluded; only route-stop names and routing tags are retained. The public ODbL derivative is network.json.gz; it contains no generated records.
